audit.why: TRICKY 7/10: even early since mounted Rell has no ranged threat, then Ferromancy: Crash Down (W) engage plus Magnet Storm (R) chained hard CC outpaces reactive healing from 6 onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 level-chart rows disagreed between layers: phases[0-3].side said Rell while win[0-3] content said Skill, and phases[4-6].side said Skill while win[4-6] content said Rell.
audit.why: Mounted Rell has no ranged poke and Shattering Strike (Q, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) only hits point-blank, so levels 1-5 are a wash where the owner dictates range; Magnet Storm (R, 120/100/80s) then drags the whole lane together for a follow-up Wish can't prevent, matching content whys[0-6].
audit.corrected: Realigned all 7 phases[N].side to match win[N] and rewrote the matching why-text and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two missingInteractions were absent: her Q/W shields absorb burst before you commit, and Full Tilt (E) opens with an auto-attack-reset wind-up that's the real tell, not the ability cast.
audit.why: Both change the read on when to actually engage or back off.
audit.corrected: Folded both into dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.
